== Description ==
'''UI-200''' is the 9th entity you may encounter within [[Section Interchange]], more info below.

== Behavior ==
When '''UI-200''' spawns, it will play the composition known as "Horror Race", like all the other entities that reside within the I-Section. If there are more entities present, it will play the same song but with a higher pitch and speed.

It will place itself infront the door similar to [[UI-83]] and [[UI-173]], rushing backtracks, unlike them it will then rushes back to the door after a few seconds.

== Strategy & Tips ==
hide immediately when you hear/See it, and stay hidden untill it comes back and hits the door

== Trivia ==
* Like most UI entities, '''UI-200''' was added as a joke.
